description: This file contains CKEditor 5 plugin code for fullscreen mode, including classes for handling fullscreen UI, commands, and plugin initialization, as well as translation strings and style insertion logic.

classes.name: Fullscreen
classes.description: Main class managing fullscreen UI, including sidebar toggles, document outline, presence list, and dialog positioning.

classes.name: FullscreenAbstractEditorHandler
classes.description: Base class for handling fullscreen mode in different editor types.

classes.name: FullscreenClassicEditorHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing fullscreen in classic editor mode.

classes.name: FullscreenDecoupledEditorHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing fullscreen in decoupled editor mode.

classes.name: FullscreenCommand
classes.description: Command class to toggle fullscreen mode.

classes.name: FullscreenEditing
classes.description: Plugin class for fullscreen editing capabilities.

classes.name: FullscreenUI
classes.description: UI plugin for fullscreen mode, adding toggle buttons and menu items.

methods.name: moveToFullscreen
methods.description: Replaces an element with a placeholder and moves it into fullscreen container.

methods.name: restoreMovedElementLocation
methods.description: Restores an element to its original location from placeholder.

methods.name: getWrapper
methods.description: Creates or returns the main fullscreen wrapper element.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Activates fullscreen mode, hiding other elements and adjusting UI.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Deactivates fullscreen mode, restoring original UI layout.

methods.name: defaultOnEnter
methods.description: Sets up the fullscreen wrapper with initial content.

methods.name: _destroyContainer
methods.description: Removes the fullscreen container element.

methods.name: _generatePresenceListContainer
methods.description: Creates and moves presence list UI into fullscreen.

methods.name: _generateDocumentOutlineContainer
methods.description: Creates and moves document outline UI into fullscreen.

methods.name: _restoreDocumentOutlineDefaultContainer
methods.description: Restores document outline container to default.

methods.name: _generateCollapseButton
methods.description: Creates toggle button for collapsing/expanding sidebars.

methods.name: _overrideAnnotationsUIs
methods.description: Overrides annotations UI for fullscreen mode.

methods.name: _restoreAnnotationsUIs
methods.description: Restores annotations UI to original state.

methods.name: _overrideRevisionHistoryCallbacks
methods.description: Overrides revision history callbacks for fullscreen.

methods.name: _restoreRevisionHistoryCallbacks
methods.description: Restores revision history callbacks.

methods.name: _registerFullscreenDialogPositionAdjustments
methods.description: Adjusts dialog positions in fullscreen.

methods.name: _unregisterFullscreenDialogPositionAdjustments
methods.description: Removes dialog position adjustments.

methods.name: _updateDialogPosition
methods.description: Updates dialog position in fullscreen.

methods.name: _setNewDialogPosition
methods.description: Calculates and sets new dialog position.

methods.name: _saveAncestorsScrollPositions
methods.description: Saves scroll positions of ancestor elements.

methods.name: _handleAITabsTransfer
methods.description: Transfers AI tabs UI into fullscreen.

methods.name: _handleAISidebarTransitions
methods.description: Handles transition events for AI sidebar.

methods.name: _restoreAITabs
methods.description: Restores AI tabs UI from fullscreen.

methods.name: _adjustVisibleElements
methods.description: Adjusts visibility of sidebars based on space.

methods.name: _switchAnnotationsUI
methods.description: Switches annotations UI mode.

methods.name: _setupResizeObserver
methods.description: Sets up resize observer for layout adjustments.

methods.name: _hideLeftSidebar
methods.description: Collapses the left sidebar.

methods.name: _showLeftSidebar
methods.description: Expands the left sidebar.

methods.name: _hideRightSidebar
methods.description: Collapses the right sidebar.

methods.name: _showRightSidebar
methods.description: Expands the right sidebar.
